profile.headline: AI Engineer | Full Stack Tech Lead
profile.summary: Full stack tech lead with nine years of experience building reusable frameworks, secure APIs, and cloud-native services that other engineering teams build on, in regulated banking, healthcare, and logistics environments. Deep expertise in Java 21 / Spring Boot and React, with production discipline in security, CI/CD, architecture governance, and API design. Now building agentic AI systems with multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) across OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini APIs, focused on making AI agents secure, reusable, and production-ready.
profile.heroHeadline: Building intelligent software. Exploring the future of AI.
profile.heroCopy: I'm a full stack tech lead with nine years of experience shipping secure APIs and cloud-native services in banking, healthcare, and logistics. Now I'm applying that production discipline to agentic AI: multi-agent systems, tool calling, and MCP.
about: I build the layer other teams depend on: reusable frameworks, secure APIs, and cloud-native services. Over nine years that has meant regulated environments in banking, healthcare, and logistics, where security, auditability, and release discipline are part of the definition of done.

At PNC Bank I own the architecture, API contracts, security model, deployment strategy, and production support for a Java 21 / Spring Boot extension layer on NICE Actimize, supporting anti-money-laundering detection. That is also where AI entered my day job: I built an LLM-powered agent and MCP server for compliance analysts, with access controls and audit logging, and I led AI enablement for engineers: usage guidelines and security review of AI tools.

Alongside that work I have been going deep on agentic AI. I completed the AI Engineer Agentic Track (Udemy), earned the Agentic AI certificate from DeepLearning.AI, and built multi-agent systems with the OpenAI Agents SDK and MCP. This site is the most complete example: an AI twin of me, grounded on a structured profile, with automated checks for what it should and should not say.

projects.name: AI Digital Twin (this website)
projects.summary: An interactive AI representation of me, grounded on a structured profile and deployed on AWS with infrastructure as code.
projects.problem: Let visitors ask questions about my background and work, and get answers grounded in documented facts instead of reading a static page.
approach: Next.js static site served from S3 and CloudFront; the chat calls a FastAPI service on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway.
The model is called through the Amazon Bedrock Converse API with the system prompt in the dedicated system field.
A structured JSON profile is the single source of truth for both the website and the twin's knowledge; the whole profile fits in the prompt, so no vector database is used.
Server-side input validation, per-client rate limiting, safe error responses, and structured logs (latency, token usage, model and prompt versions) without message contents.
Offline automated tests and a separate opt-in live evaluation suite covering grounding, missing information, invented achievements, and prompt-extraction attempts.
Infrastructure managed with Terraform workspaces (dev, test, prod) and deployed through GitHub Actions.
projects.limits: Responses are returned whole rather than streamed, because API Gateway HTTP APIs do not stream Lambda responses.

projects.name: Career Digital Twin Agent

projects.problem: Answer recruiter questions about my background and make sure questions the agent cannot answer are not lost.
approach: Uses tool calling to log unanswered questions and capture contact details, with push notifications.
Built with Python and the OpenAI API, with a Gradio interface, deployed on Hugging Face Spaces.

projects.problem: Turn a research question into a structured report by coordinating several specialised agents.
approach: A planner agent, search agents, and a writer agent built on the OpenAI Agents SDK.
Web searches run in parallel with asyncio.
The report is synthesized with Pydantic-typed outputs and emailed.

projects.name: Agentic Trading Simulation with MCP

Multiple MCP servers: market data, accounts, and memory.
A live Gradio dashboard for monitoring. Trades are simulated.
flow: MCP servers: market data, accounts, memory
projects.limits: A simulation only; it does not place real trades.
